# Raigulus

> Raigulus publishes The Division 2 walkthroughs, Broken Rain Incursion and raid clears, build guides, Conflict PvP, Dark Zone, Regulus, and gameplay clips.

The canonical website is https://raigulus.github.io. The YouTube handle is @raigulus.

## Legal

- [Privacy Notice](https://raigulus.github.io/privacy/): Data, analytics consent, feedback, retention, and rights.
- [Cookie Notice](https://raigulus.github.io/cookies/): Cookies and storage, including analytics, YouTube, Giscus, Discord, and Web3Forms.
- [Terms & Disclaimer](https://raigulus.github.io/terms/): Unofficial fan site, no warranty, account-action disclaimer, external links, comments, and copyright.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://raigulus.github.io/): Raigulus channel and guide overview.
